input.text: Keep no more than $15,000 in a teller drawer at any time.
sources: A teller drawer may not hold more than $15,000 at any time.

input.text: The vault must be opened under dual control with two employees present.
sources: The vault must be opened under dual control, with two employees present.

input.text: Vault combinations are changed every 6 months. They are also changed whenever an employee who knows the combination leaves.
sources: Vault combinations are changed every 6 months and whenever an employee who knows the combination leaves.

input.text: Staff send the customer an acknowledgment no later than 2 business days after a written complaint arrives.
sources: Send the customer an acknowledgment no later than 2 business days after a written complaint arrives.

input.text: Complaints that allege unfair treatment are escalated to management the same day.
sources: Complaints that allege unfair treatment are escalated to management the same day.
